content: Pentamidine is a medication that may cause serious side effects. However, your doctor has prescribed this drug because they have determined that the potential benefits to you outweigh the risks associated with these side effects. Severe allergic reactions to this medication are rare. This document does not provide a complete list of possible side effects. If you are in the United States or Canada and experience side effects, contact your doctor for medical advice. Before using pentamidine, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other problems. Pentamidine may cause dizziness, and consuming alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can exacerbate this effect. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or engaging in activities requiring alertness until you are sure you can do so safely. Limit your intake of alcoholic beverages. Pentamidine may lead to a condition affecting the heart's rhythm, known as QT prolongation. The risk of QT prolongation may increase if you have certain medical conditions or are taking other medications that can cause QT prolongation. Low levels of potassium or magnesium in the blood can also elevate your risk of QT prolongation. This risk may be heightened if you are using certain drugs, such as diuretics (water pills), or if you have conditions like severe sweating, diarrhea, or vomiting. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It is not known whether this medication passes into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase your risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. If someone has overdosed and exhibits serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Laboratory and/or medical tests (such as kidney/liver function, blood pressure, blood sugar, complete blood counts, and EKGs) should be performed before starting this medication, during its use, and after completing treatment. Ensure you attend all medical and laboratory appointments. It is crucial to take each dose of this medication as scheduled. If you miss a dose, consult your doctor or pharmacist immediately for a new dosing schedule. For storage instructions, refer to the product guidelines and consult your pharmacist. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individual medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
